figurative_meaning_en: Sarcastically, a companion in evil deeds or a friend of villains
similar_in_english: birds of a feather flock together
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে সাঙাতের সাথে মিশে খারাপ কাজে লিপ্ত হয়েছে।
তোর এই সাঙাতগুলো তোকে ধ্বংসের দিকে নিয়ে যাবে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has gotten involved in bad deeds by mixing with that bad companion.
These bad companions of yours will lead you to ruin.
note: This idiom reflects Bengali cultural emphasis on choosing good company, with variations arising from regional dialects and pronunciations.
